decision.decision_text: The owner requests a bounded correction to the same G3 r2 revision: the inspector must match the pilot geometry rather than remain constrained to a small pane; the specimen must visibly include the pilot-derived table pattern and control icons grouped on a shared backing surface; and the review must support element-by-element pilot-to-realization verification.
